before: After the last record that the review queue leaves out was resolved, the layout cache key of the review filter changed, and every paragraph was measured again.
after: The review filter keeps its layout cache key while the styles and numbering stay the same, so only the blocks that changed are measured again, and a story's block list is built again when the left-out records change.
reason: Only local layout cache keys and the local list of projected story blocks change. Shared nodes, operations, review items, and package serialization remain unchanged.
